column3: Fast mode is OpenAI's priority service_tier, offered (modes: ["fast"]) only on the openai provider's openai-responses models, stored per conversation in an xin.fast doc and sent by a beforeProviderRequest hook; this corrects the 2026-11-15 row that said pi-ai 1.5 has no service-tier mode
column4: pi-ai 1.5 sends service_tier on openai-responses and openai-codex-responses and multiplies cost by the tier the response reports (priority 2x, 2.5x for one model), so the price is real; gateways and other providers on the same API have no priority tier, and Codex reports default for a priority request, so a body-only tier would be priced at default there; Anthropic has no speed option in pi-ai; README names beforeProviderRequest for provider-specific fields
column5: plugins/models/fast.test.ts: modes only on openai models, refusal on a faux model, drop on switch, priority payload only for openai-responses on openai
